ops.oldText: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
ops.newText: Vendor will be a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services, and Customer may procure the same or similar services from any third party at any time.

input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the sole-and-exclusive supplier commitment so that we remain free to source hosted analytics services elsewhere, consistent with our playbook position against exclusivity binding the customer. If exclusivity matters commercially, we could discuss a narrow category-specific arrangement capped at 12 months that ends automatically if service levels or delivery dates are missed.
input.summary: Convert Vendor's sole and exclusive provider status to non-exclusive supply.
